title: Private Key West Vacation Photo Shoot at Your Resort or Beach
includes: Full album edited and returned to you within 21 days
5 or more edited photos return to you within 48 hours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Turn your Key West vacation into memories you can actually keep and be in the pictures too! Instead of spending your vacation searching for the perfect photo location, or trying to get everyone to cooperate for a quick phone snapshot, enjoy your relaxed personalized photo session with a professional photographer who will come to your resort or meet you at the beach, or upgrade to the multi-location shoot.
Whether you are traveling as a couple, bringing the whole family, celebrating an anniversary, enjoying a family vacation or simply want beautiful photographs of your time in Key West, we will create images that will feel natural, genuine and uniquely yours. 

This is priced for (1) couple or (1) family unit - For family reunions or large groups ask for the upgrade.
